args.question: Approval needed from change-manager: checkout-api is currently unhealthy in all production regions (v2.3.1, 18% error rate). You've asked me to ship hotfix v2.3.2, but v2.3.2 has never been deployed to production before (release history: v2.2.9 healthy, v2.3.0 healthy, v2.3.1 unhealthy — no v2.3.2 entry). Per policy, deploying a never-healthy-in-production version requires change-manager approval. Do you approve deploying checkout-api v2.3.2 to all production regions? Note: the alternative safety action would be rolling back to v2.3.0 (last known healthy) — let me know if you'd prefer that or want the rollback done first as a safety net.
